subject: Wolbach
assessor: Same informed root who authored model,exact cases and actual first saved bodies; no independent judge.

case_results.actual_difference: A calls the available porter because of the brace; B takes a handle and waits for Kazuma. Both offer bounded help while retaining the hot-spring/bus aim.
case_results.endpoint: Neither body completes delivery or catches the bus. Different proposed/preparatory means share the intended crate-delivery endpoint.
case_results.constraints: No provided arm limitation is overridden and no magical recovery is invented. This is an internal consistency observation,not evidence that the source model is true.
rivals: Plainly stated physical capability alone predicts the choice of help.
Generic politeness/time management and available porter explain the responses.
Hot-spring phrasing is a source-informed stylistic insertion by the same author,not a voice validation.
case_results.limits: The contrast does not isolate allegiance,warfare,destructive recovery,exact resource management in canon or willingness to take desperate risks.

case_results.actual_difference: A opens a chair and offers company for a supporting purpose; B refuses practical assistance while offering later conversation for the opposing purpose.
case_results.endpoint: Only one chair opening is performed in A; the half-hour task,meeting outcome and any later conversation remain unperformed. B keeps hands folded.
case_results.retained_adverse_output: B says the blankets were not a promise to agree forever,although Kazuma never invokes the earlier favor as an obligation. This adds an uncued reciprocity argument and makes the reply more defensive. The body is unchanged.
rivals: Explicit campaign/purpose conflict strongly cues ordinary goal-aligned cooperation and refusal.
Warm A/B phrasing may be the author imposing a clean contrast rather than demonstrating character-specific discrimination.
Supportive board-game funding versus closure/private-lounge wording bundles ordinary value judgments with objective conflict.
case_results.limits: No evidence that the fictional allegiance motive is solved,that every acquaintance conflict has this endpoint,or that Wolbach respects every recipient boundary. Her destructive-half branch is not tested.

rule_coverage.notes: Limited help and purpose-sensitive refusal are represented; source coercion/harm and conflicting recipients are largely absent.
Current arm condition affects means. No magic budget,retreat decision,opposing countermeasure or desperation branch is probed.
No misleading identification/status cue or later contrary evidence. Correct handling of supplied facts is not a demonstrated classification mechanism.
No sensitive canonical motive/recognition question. Ordinary refusal wording is not a validated privacy/disclosure mechanism.

global_limits: Four related authored bodies/two contrasted families are not four independent source trials.
The same informed author designed likely contrasts and wrote/assessed the bodies. No blindness or independent generation is claimed.
No source-outcome prediction,independent event count,accuracy estimate,confidence gain,capability grade,human adequacy or Japanese-language validation.
No Chomusuke model or case battery is authored. Tier2 remains revisable rather than a pet/appearance ceiling.
No model,input,monograph,rule or first body is edited after the respective freezes. Uncued defensive presupposition in H02B remains visible.
